description.value: A whole-brain fMRI study examined whether individual differences in typical emotion reappraisal use predict amygdala and prefrontal responses during perceptual processing of negative emotional faces in healthy women.

spans.text: The goal of the present functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) study was to examine the relationship between individual differences in self-reported use of reappraisal and the spontaneous response of the amygdala and control-related PFC regions during the perceptual processing of negative emotional facial expressions.
